scope_and_limitations: Synthetic demonstration only. No real application was audited. All observations below are fictional and cannot be used as assurance.

evidence.description: Fictional test records for demonstrating decision boundaries; not runtime observations.

findings.reason: Fictional create action shows success but makes no required write.
findings.requirement_or_goal: Create must store the submitted record.
findings.affected_users_and_conditions: All test users creating a record.
findings.change_scope_cost_risk: Scoped correction to existing save handler; low cost; verify duplicate and error behavior.
findings.verification_plan: Create marker DEMO-1; independently read the committed record and compare fields.

findings.reason: Fictional local persistence survives the required refresh/reopen; cloud sync is only a preference.
findings.requirement_or_goal: Local-only data must survive refresh/reopen; device sync is excluded.
findings.affected_users_and_conditions: Single-device users reopening the local editor.
findings.change_scope_cost_risk: Retain the existing local storage design; no demonstrated benefit from a database migration.
findings.verification_plan: Recheck marker DEMO-2 after refresh and a complete app reopen.

findings.reason: Fictional measured correction flow meets its target; optional undo may reduce correction time but needs a product decision.
findings.requirement_or_goal: Correction must complete within the agreed task budget, already satisfied.
findings.affected_users_and_conditions: Users correcting a reversible edit.
findings.change_scope_cost_risk: New undo interaction changes product scope; compare cost and error consequences before implementation.
findings.verification_plan: Compare correction time and error rate with target users using the same task and prior goal.

findings.reason: Fictional button patterns follow the established design; a new color is taste without benefit.
findings.requirement_or_goal: Equivalent save controls follow the established pattern.
findings.affected_users_and_conditions: Users moving between the two example screens.
findings.change_scope_cost_risk: Preserve the current design; a redesign has cost without demonstrated benefit.
findings.verification_plan: Compare save controls and repeat the same interaction on both screens.
